item.title: Nephimhr
item.description:
The dragons’ refuge.

Beyond

They sustain it with their own essence, and are bound there by it.

item.title: The Drain
item.description:
Life pulled from the world through lenses, cast through the obelisk, and thrown back as rainbows.

Beyond

It is a dial. Boil the frog slowly, and crank it up to punish.

item.title: The Turning
item.description:
The story everyone is taught: the rainbows are the gods’ gift of peace.

Beyond

It is propaganda. The rainbows are the visible exhaust of the drain.

item.title: The Unicorns
item.description:
The parasites.

Beyond

They drain life through lenses into the obsidian obelisk, which prisms it into the rainbows. They rule by divide-and-conquer – they set the tribes and creatures against each other and directed the Vessel People to break the dragons – and by manufactured consent: controlled schooling and the Turning myth.
